text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hours and hours of rain stretching
well into the afternoon, the
clouds finally
clear away, signaling the start of the
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this place is packed with people! I'm
not surprised
though—Grass Wonder's
going to be racing today!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
The track doesn't look too good after all
that rain... but I'm sure this is
nothing for
Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hello,
King! Let's have a good race today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the honor of facing me,
Grass!
I'll show you what a
first-rate running style
looks like!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …So, you're here again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You're more stubborn than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind though.
If that's how badly
you want to watch me run,
then I'll give
you a show! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looks like King's doing just fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, nah. I didn't have much to do
today, so I'm just here to kill
some time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, looks like the race is starting.
You better pay close
attention. If she finds
out you weren't properly looking, she'll
get all upset.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Clear the way! I'm coming through!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, King Halo's charging to the front!
Maybe she's good at races
that require
power, just like her mother?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. It's too early to say for sure
yet. Let's keep watching.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I will... prove that... I'm first-rate!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, this is new from King. I guess she
doesn't wanna get stuck
again in the
middle of the pack like at the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But her body's stiffening up under all
that energy she's putting in. This always
happens to her whenever she gets too
pent up about
something.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a shame. If only she learned to
relax and run more freely...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's the final stretch! Look,
Grass Wonder's
coming!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's a force to be reckoned with! I don't
see a hint of weakness in
her gait! The gap
between her and King is rapidly
increasing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looks like Grass ended up being
the star of today's show.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the race comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I always knew Grass Wonder would win.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like she's accepting any
scouting offers right now, but
I'd love to
have a chat with her at the next tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Me too! As for King Halo... well, I'm sure
she got a reality check after
seeing today's
results.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Next time will be different! Get
ready everyone, because
you all haven't
even seen my best yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other trainers turn to her with a look
of exasperation on their
faces as she
flaunts her usual demeanor.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right, pay careful attention!
Remember my words—I am King
Halo, the
first-rate racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of the defeats,
disappointments, or ridicule, her endless

commitment pushes her to the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If commitment is what she wants to see,
then there's only one thing
for me to do!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Umm... are you okay? Did you mistake her
for Grass Wonder?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You do realize the person in front of
you is
King Halo, right?

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Murmur...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you have what it takes to
push the boundaries of my
overwhelming
talent?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you're ready to become an
unstoppable force and
spread my name
around the world?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
Everyone here—listen up!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
From this day forward, I,
the first-rate King
Halo, will join hands with
this first-rate
trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Get ready because we're going to take the
Twinkle Series by storm and win every
race! Better grab a pair of sunglasses so
you don't get
blinded by our glory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer. We have documents to
sign!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, why on earth did you do that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly understand what calling
yourself "first-rate" in front of
everyone is
going to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
People are going to laugh at you and
make fun of you behind your back. The
world will crush your shoulders. But you
can't take those
words back.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what a dummy. You're more stubborn
and clumsy than I could've
ever imagined!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...But I guess it's not a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz... Bzzz...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Mother again...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? A statement?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Now that's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I'm going to answer now. Are you
ready? On three! One,
two...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my pursuit of first-rate greatness
with King Halo officially
begins.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Mother? I have an announcement to
make. No, I'm not going
home. In fact, let
me introduce my new trainer to you!
